809782.synopsis:
Disguise might be able to hide the truth, but it can never hide the feelings born within the heart. When a female bodyguard must protect a mischievous young lady who is the light of her life... how will this love story end? 

(Source: KongthupsPdc X) Edit Translation English Русский Français Español

798978.title: A Quiet Bloom
798978.synopsis:
Marketing specialist Iris returns to Cebu, dreading confrontations with her overly traditional mother who constantly pressures her about marriage. After a heated argument, she escapes on her motorcycle to the only place still open—a flower café where owner Hyacinth offers her warm tea and unexpected kindness. Iris returns nightly, needing the café's Wi-Fi for work. Hyacinth, whose struggling business could use marketing help, welcomes the arrangement.

802502.title: In Love Forever
802502.native: วาดฝันวันวิวาห์
802502.synopsis:
A glamorous lawyer and a Gen-Z heiress divorce after family pressure tears their marriage apart. But when a major business deal forces them to reunite and fake a happy relationship, old feelings begin to resurface. As love rekindles and hidden wounds reopen, the couple must decide whether their broken marriage deserves a second chance—or if some scars can never heal.

(Source: BEC World)

810646.title: Midnight Mart
810646.synopsis:
Kim So Hui is an IT worker who practically lives for her job. Every day she goes to the company, stays late doing overtime, and after work, she always goes to the same convenience store to buy a beer. One day she meets Ji Eun, the cashier at the store, who awakens feelings in her that she hasn't felt in a long time.

(Source: MyDramaList) Edit Translation English Deutsch Español Português (Brasil)
